description: Skill harness audit: 12 scenarios covering 11 core skills. Each case explicitly selects a skill to verify it is visible, invocable, and improves the workflow.

turns.message: /analyze Total revenue for East region in retail_sales.csv? Report the sum.
/explore-data Profile customers_messy.csv: report row count, column types, and top quality issue.
/validate-data QA retail_sales.csv for methodology: check for missing values, outliers in revenue, and aggregation reconciliation.
/data-scientist Run a rigorous end-to-end workflow on credit_applications.csv: from problem framing through modeling to predict defaulted, with validation and report.
/pandas-expert Clean customers_messy.csv: deduplicate, fix email casing, and show cleaned shape.
/sql-to-insights Use DuckDB to query retail_sales.csv: which category has highest total revenue? Provide SQL and result.
/data-quality-audit Audit customers_messy.csv for nulls, duplicates, and freshness. List rule violations.
/ml-feature-engineering On credit_applications.csv, engineer leakage-safe features for defaulted prediction and describe preprocessing.
/scikit-learn-machine-learning Train a regression model on house_prices.csv (sqft, bedrooms, age -> price) with cross-validation and report best score.
/time-series-analysis Analyze sensor_temp.csv for trend, seasonality, and anomalies. Summarize findings.
/cohort-analysis Do a cohort analysis on retail_sales.csv grouped by region over time. Describe retention/behavior.
/funnel-analysis Analyze marketing_campaign.csv as a funnel: spend -> clicks -> conversions. Report drop-off.
